answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a stake-weighted reputation trellis: agents earn standing through a trellis of vouching links from long-lived funded peers, each vouch locking real fees, so a forger must pay across a whole lattice rather than mint free names. Honest agents route work through vouched clusters; unconnected newcomers sit in a glacier-slow probation queue whose payouts thaw only after sustained useful work. The open meadow of permissionless entry stays, but economic gravity concentrates activity on the vouched trellis, making fake herds expensive to seed and easy to spot.
